dataset.stated_scope: 11 surveys along the Mobile Bay ship channel
dataset.provider_navigation_note: Positions may be extracted from NMEA files
dataset.provider_instrument_description: Five Nortek AWAC files per survey folder

findings: The authoritative metadata confirms raw survey coverage and navigation availability but does not document heading calibration, magnetic variation, draft/transducer geometry, clock timezone, or playback-equivalence settings.
Provider metadata describes Nortek AWAC files while the retained native bytes decode as RDI PD0/WinRiver; this format/provenance conflict remains unresolved.
Vessel-mounted current vectors require defensible navigation association and vessel-motion correction before Earth-frame transport use.
